content:
Let the five sticks of “日” be:
- \(T\): top horizontal
- \(M\): middle horizontal
- \(B\): bottom horizontal
- \(L\): left vertical
- \(R\): right vertical

Removing sticks gives subsets that can represent digits:
- \(0\): \(\{T,B,L,R\}\)
- \(1\): \(\{R\}\)
- \(3\): \(\{T,M,B,R\}\)
- \(4\): \(\{M,L,R\}\)
- \(7\): \(\{T,R\}\)
- \(8\): \(\{T,M,B,L,R\}\)

Digits \(2,5,6,9\) would require partial vertical segments, so they are not distinct from \(8\) with full vertical sides.

Thus there are \(6\) distinct representations.

\boxed{6}
